articles.title: 'Das Kadam, Das Ka Dam': Sambit Patra highlights 10 key outcomes of PM Modi's recent foreign visits
articles.summary: BJP MP Sambit Patra outlined ten key outcomes from PM Modi's recent visits to Indonesia, Australia, New Zealand and Seychelles, highlighting strengthened strategic, defence, economic and cultural partnerships with Indo-Pacific nations.

articles.title: Deepened bonds, strengthened partnerships: PM Modi concludes three-nation visit, departs from NZ to India
articles.summary: PM Modi concluded his three-nation visit to Indonesia, Australia and New Zealand, with India-New Zealand ties elevated to a Strategic Partnership and 18 key outcomes announced across defence, trade, and cooperation sectors.

articles.title: PM Modi is "quintessential" politician, prefers direct contact with electorate: MEA
articles.summary: India's Ministry of External Affairs stated that PM Modi, as a quintessential Indian politician, prefers direct contact with his electorate rather than press conferences during his official visit to New Zealand.

articles.title: "When India's Chandrayaan landed on Moon, all of New Zealand rejoiced": PM Modi hails increasing space sector collaboration
articles.summary: PM Modi highlighted India-New Zealand collaboration in the space sector, noting that New Zealand's technology contributed to India's Chandrayaan lunar mission success during his community address in Auckland.

articles.title: 'Bond with India remains unwavering': PM Modi after meeting diaspora in New Zealand
articles.summary: PM Modi met with members of the Indian diaspora in New Zealand, expressing gratitude for their enthusiasm and reaffirming their strong bond with India during the first Indian PM visit to the country in four decades.
